From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 06 Nov 2028 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Weekly renewal pipeline — commit & stage refresh (BrightByte focus)

Hi team,

Quick reminder for this week's renewal hygiene pass. Finance needs committed ARR in HubSpot for the month-end forecast — please update stage and commit notes for any deals you own by EOD Wednesday (Nov 8).

Priority: BrightByte (Deal DEAL-7891) — renewal target: 2029-01-15. Current notes in HubSpot look stale; I attached a blank commit table for this sweep. Specific asks: 
- Confirm customer intent: Commit / Upside / At-Risk.
- If At-Risk, add a 1-sentence rationale and expected blocker (pricing, security, exec sponsor).
- Update expected close date if it has slipped.
- Add any open action owners (CS, Sales, Legal) and ETA.

Why this matters: Finance will bake committed ARR into the Q1 plan on Nov 10. We need a defensible book of committed deals and clear flags for churn-risk. If you think a credit/exception will be requested, note it here so we can route for approvals early.

Attachments: commit_table.csv (please overwrite your rows and upload back to the folder). I reviewed BrightByte and flagged two risk signals: reduced monthly usage trend and an unresolved audit question in the security questionnaire. Marissa — can you confirm product fit alignment and whether the SOC evidence ETA moved?

Thanks — small updates now avoid larger forecast churn later.

Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Head of Renewals Ops | Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai

Thanks Sofia — updated the sheet and logging the short answers here for visibility. See bolded rows in commit_table.csv (attached).

BrightByte (DEAL-7891) — update:
- Current stage: Renewing (was: Proposal)
- Forecast status: Commit (I have verbal from Ethan; they confirmed exec approval is aligned but are negotiating term length)
- Churn signals: usage dip (-12% MoM) but product fit confirmed via last week’s POC.
- Open blockers: final SOW term length (12 vs. 24 months), legal redline on data-retention clause (BrightByte asked for a 24-month retention limit).
- Action owner: Marissa (lead), Legal (Naomi) — ETA for SOW redline: 48 hours once legal receives customer markup.

I attached BrightByte_MA_plan_Q1.pdf (mutual action plan) with the milestone dates I discussed with Ethan. I've also pushed the commit flag in HubSpot and set expected close to 2029-01-15; I added the qualifying note about term negotiation.

If Legal can confirm the retention clause won't require a platform change, we keep this as Commit. If Legal requires a technical limitation or roadmap change, mark At-Risk and escalate.

-Marissa

Marissa / Sofia — thanks for the note and the MAP. Confirming intent to renew; we're leaning toward a 24-month term for price stability. Our legal team will send a redline on the retention clause by EOD Friday (Nov 10).

A couple of operational asks:
- Can you add a clause for quarterly usage reviews into the SOW? That's important for our procurement.
- We may request a small pilot-level credit if usage stays <70% for two consecutive months in the first quarter.

I'll upload our redline and the PO to the DocuSign envelope once ready. Please let me know if there are any specific datapoints your FP&A team needs before Nov 10.

Best,
